description: Call before any cross-chain USDC/USDT transfer (free, no signature, no key, stores nothing). Give the corridor and the amount, and optionally the route you would use (baseline_provider). Returns your route's estimated total cost in USDC and its arrival time; and, when Recta proves a cheaper route, the saving (a proven lower bound), Recta's 5 % fee, that route's total cost and arrival, and execute_via_recta: the body to sign to get the route. Example: base -> arbitrum, 1000 USDC, against lifi. 3 a day per IP address.

amount.description: How much of source_asset to send, in whole tokens: "1000" with USDC means 1,000 USDC.

baseline_provider.description: Optional: the route you would use without Recta, e.g. lifi, across, stargate_v2, cctp_v2_standard. Absent: lifi (LI.FI's own quote), or across where LI.FI does not apply.

sender.description: Optional: the EVM address the transfer would leave from, for the most exact figure. With a key it is ignored: the sender is the local wallet.

source_asset.description: Asset moved, e.g. USDC or USDT.

source_network.description: Source network key, e.g. base, arbitrum, ethereum, optimism, polygon.

name: recta_preflight
